caseName: Greater New Orleans Broadcasting Ass'n v. United States
caseNameFull: Greater New Orleans Broadcasting Assn., Inc. v. United States

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Certiorari *1098granted. Brief of petitioners is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Thursday, February 25, 1999. Brief of the Solicitor General is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Wednesday, March 24, 1999. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, April 12, 1999. This Court’s Bule 29.2 does not apply.
